This huge structure was present on the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] that was used to monitor the planet surface.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this planet became the site of a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Although the CIS overwhelmed the Republic, Anakin knew that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] were sending reinforcements so he destroyed the scanner mast using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] ensuring that the CIS [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] would be oblivious to the Republic reinforcements.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />
